# Lucide icons

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/53fab88ff9d1b48f4704b5b5b560d6b4d560bf4c/icons

ISC/MIT; see LICENSE. Path elements of the named SVGs are stored and rendered separately, without changing coordinates; stroke follows the original 24px / 2px round style. Locally bundled, no runtime requests or added package.

Chosen as a consistent outline set with distinct help/stop symbols. A full comparison with every DADS illustration asset has not been performed. Icon meanings still require participant confirmation.
